text:
emily.hsu: Heads-up: publishing a compliance addendum and a "data residency toggle" option for Private/VPC installs. Goal: give customers an explicit toggle + SOW clause to opt into region-local persistence and a clear telemetry retention default.

marco.lei: Nice. Does this cover FedRAMP/FIPS requirements or is it just a residency/cust-data control?

emily.hsu: Primary focus is residency + retention + telemetry opt-in. We also added a mapping appendix that shows which toggles map to FedRAMP/FIPS controls (non-normative). Not a certification by itself, but helps customers scope gaps.

legal-bot: Added SOW clause draft: SOW-RESID-2.0. Key line: "Customer may elect region-local persistence; Redwood will not export persistent customer data outside designated regions unless explicitly authorized in writing." Reviewed by @legal.

ben.prod: Rollout ask: whats the migration path for existing Private installs that currently use global persistence? Do we provide a one-click migration or a staged export/import?

emily.hsu: For GA, were shipping a staged migration plan:
- Phase 1: advisory + config freeze window.
- Phase 2: snapshot export to customer-controlled S3 (or target storage) 
- Phase 3: import into region-local store + validation.
We will not force migrations. Migration tooling will be a CLI helper and runbook for PS.

zara.cs: For CS comms: can we get a short script and an FAQ? customers will ask about downtime and cost.

emily.hsu: yes. Draft KB here: https://internal.redwood/kb/onprem-residency-addendum (internal) 
Short AE script: "We now offer a region-local persistence toggle for Private installs. It keeps persistent artifacts in your chosen region; telemetry can still be shared if you opt in. We recommend testing in a staging window; PS will coordinate the migration and validation."

marco.lei: A few technical notes to add to the appendix: NTP/time sync dependency, KMS key residency (avoid cross-region CMK references), and recommended network egress controls.

emily.hsu: noted. Adding NTP and KMS residency notes. Also adding a sample KMS policy snippet: 
```
Resource: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
Condition: StringEquals: kms:EncryptionContext: {"redwood:customer": "example-corp"}
```

legal-bot: Also added a telemetry opt-out checkbox sample for the SOW and the customer signoff clause.

ben.prod: Dependencies: we need platform feature flag to prevent accidental cross-region writes. @eng-platform can we gate writes by default?

emily.hsu: request filed with eng-platform. ticket: PLAT-2473. Target: feature-flag ready for PS by next sprint (est. 2 weeks).

kb-publisher-bot: KB draft published to internal preview: /kb/onprem-residency-addendum (editor link) 

zara.cs: ETA for customer-facing announcement? sales wants a one-pager + email copy.

emily.hsu: Plan: publish internal KB + PS runbook today, one-pager and AE email copy by EOD tomorrow, public announcement (if customer opt-ins exceed pilot threshold) later.

marco.lei: One more ask: include test checklist item to verify time drift < 1s and encrypted swap off. Had a bad install once where swap leaked metadata.

emily.hsu: adding test item. thanks.

kb-publisher-bot: Reminder: "Residency addendum review" scheduled at 1801234780 for @marco.lei @zara.cs.

emily.hsu: Please review the draft and leave inline comments in the KB. This is customer-facing legal/compliance content so keep suggestions concrete. :memo: 

ben.prod: thumbs-up from product/engineering side. Keep me posted on PLAT-2473 progress.

zara.cs: will prep CS FAQ and sample email; pinging AE leads after one-pager is ready.

legal-bot: Final note: ensure opt-out paths are explicit and documented to avoid surprise telemetry charges.

emily.hsu: acknowledged. Closing: will merge v1.0 at 1801234800 unless a blocker is raised.
